name: com.nodajimarket/catalog
title: NodajiMarket
description: Korean art & craft by named artists: search, artists, exhibitions, duty-included quotes, checkout.

tools.name: nodajimarket_search_products
tools.description: Search NodajiMarket's curated catalogue of Korean handcrafted goods and artworks by named artists. Artworks marked coa ship with an artist-signed certificate of authenticity. Prices are in USD (integer cents); for the US and Canada the checkout total is DDP — duties and import taxes included, nothing more to pay on delivery; other destinations ship DAP (the buyer pays duties and taxes on delivery) — get_landed_cost returns incoterm per destination. Returns up to 20 products with price, artist, availability and lead time, plus next_cursor when there are more. Payment is completed by a human in a browser via a Stripe Checkout link (see nodajimarket_create_checkout); no tool here takes payment.

query.description: Free-text keywords (Korean or English): material, technique, artist, subject

category.description: Exact category id, e.g. craft, ink_painting, calligraphy

max_price_usd.description: Upper bound on item price in US dollars

ship_to.description: Destination country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (CA, US, JP)

tools.name: nodajimarket_get_product
tools.description: Full detail for one product: description (up to 600 chars), materials, dimensions, weight, images, variants, artist and text rights. Read-only — does not reserve or buy. Use the product id from nodajimarket_search_products.

tools.name: nodajimarket_get_artist
tools.description: Profile of one artist by slug: names (English, Korean, aliases), tagline, story, career (education, exhibitions, awards, designations, collections — all as provided by the artist, not independently verified), portrait, seal image, certificate text, and their works with availability. Read-only.

tools.name: nodajimarket_list_exhibitions
tools.description: Current and upcoming exhibitions by NodajiMarket's artists, with venue, city, dates and the works on view (product ids usable with nodajimarket_get_product). Read-only.

include_ended.description: Also list ended exhibitions (all of an artist's when artist_slug is given, otherwise those that ended in the last 90 days)

tools.name: nodajimarket_get_landed_cost
tools.description: Delivered (landed) cost for up to 10 products to one destination: items, shipping, duties estimate, tax and the DDP total in USD cents — the same numbers the store's own checkout charges. For Canada the card is charged in CAD at a fixed rate; charged.amountCents shows that. Returns supported:false with a message for destinations we do not ship to (South Korea, sanctioned countries).

quantities.description: Same length as product_ids; default 1 each

ship_to.description: Destination country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (CA, US, JP)

postal_code.description: Destination postal code — for Canada it sets the provincial tax rate

tools.name: nodajimarket_create_checkout
tools.description: Reserve stock for up to 10 products and return a Stripe Checkout link that a human opens in a browser to pay. The link expires in 30 minutes; the reservation is released if it is not paid. Shipping address, name and phone are entered on the Stripe page — do not collect them yourself. For Canada the card is charged in CAD at a fixed rate (returned as charged_amount_cents). This tool does not take payment; only the customer does, on that page. Pass a stable client_request_id so a retry returns the same link instead of reserving stock twice.

ship_to.description: Destination country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (CA, US, JP)

agent.description: Name of the calling agent, for the merchant's records
